title: BuildIt denobuild Configuration
description: Official JSON Schema configuration for BuildIt Deno.bundle compiler.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for validation and autocomplete in editors.

defineVersionString.description: Identifier of the constant for application version injection (default: '__APP_VERSION__').

versionPaths.description: List of files or directories where the generated version.ts should be ensured.

forcepackagesversion.description: If true, synchronizes the version across workspace packages.

targets.description: Dictionary of compilation targets for Deno.bundle.

default.description: Whether to build automatically when no target is specified in CLI.

srcdir.description: Source directory where entry points reside.

copyFiles.description: Sets of copy rules for static files to distdir.

includes.description: List of glob / brace expansion patterns to include.

excludes.description: List of glob / brace expansion patterns to exclude.

includes.description: Glob patterns relative to distdir to remove (use '*' for everything).

excludes.description: Glob patterns relative to distdir to preserve.

oneOf.description: Folders or files to clean before build (relative to distdir).

clean.description: Pre-build cleanup rules for output directory.

entryPoints.description: TypeScript or JavaScript entry points to bundle.

format.description: Bundle output format generated by Deno.bundle.

minify.description: Whether to minify the generated file.

codeSplitting.description: Whether to split bundle into multiple modular chunks.

inlineImports.description: Whether to inline dynamic imports directly into the bundle.

packages.description: Whether to bundle third-party dependencies or keep them external.

external.description: List of modules or packages to treat as external.

write.description: If true, Deno.bundle writes directly to disk. Defaults to false in BuildIt to allow post-processing.

keepNames.description: Whether to preserve original function and class names after minification.

globalName.description: Global variable name for exposing IIFE bundle (e.g., 'MyApp').

banner.description: Code snippets injected at the top of the generated file. Supports __APP_VERSION__.

footer.description: Code snippets injected at the bottom of the generated file. Supports __APP_VERSION__.

jsx.description: JSX transformation mode (read from deno.json by Deno.bundle).

define.description: Mapping of constants replaced in memory (e.g., define: { "__DEBUG__": "false" }).

defineAssetsString.description: Identifier of the constant for injecting the list of generated assets (e.g., '__GENERATED_ASSETS__').

outfile.description: Explicit output filename (relative to distdir if provided).
